transcript.text: Every so often when I put the washing machine on the whole kitchen power goes off and I have to go to the fuse box and flick the switch back up. It doesn't happen every time. Indesit, IWE 7 something.

⚠ Stop using this appliance
Please don't keep resetting the trip. Leave the appliance unplugged and have it checked by a qualified electrician or appliance engineer before using it again. From what you have checked, this needs an appliance engineer to look at it: the next steps are beyond the checks that are safe to do yourself.
